classification.difficultyReason: Reduce the number of revolutions modulo 24, multiply the remainders and interpret the elapsed time on a clock.

content.prompt: A satellite goes around the Earth once every 7 hours. If it is 9 a.m. now, what time will it be in 247 revolutions? (Don’t calculate $7\times247$, use modulo arithmetic.)

answer.short:
10 a.m.

The elapsed time is congruent to 1 hour modulo 24.
answer.worked:
A 24-hour clock repeats every 24 hours.

$$247\equiv7\pmod{24}$$
$$\begin{align*}7\times247&\equiv7\times7\pmod{24}\\7\times247&\equiv49\pmod{24}\\7\times247&\equiv1\pmod{24}\end{align*}$$
The time is 1 hour after 9 a.m., so it will be 10 a.m.
